facts.fact: The StackAdapt article '4 reasons to bake cookieless advertising into your media plan' was published on 2022-03-11.
StackAdapt's article lists 4 key benefits of cookieless targeting.
facts.quote: Here are 4 key benefits of cookieless targeting:

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, cookieless (contextual) advertising is not constrained by privacy legislation because it does not collect or use information about users.
facts.quote: Cookieless advertising (also known as contextual advertising) isn’t constrained by

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that some browsers, such as Apple Safari, let users block all cookies while using that browser.
facts.quote: some browsers like Apple Safari offer options for users to manage cookies and website data. A user now has the option to block all cookies while using that browser.

facts.fact: Contextual advertising targets the content of the page where an ad appears, rather than making ads relevant to the individual user's behavior as traditional behavioral targeting does.
facts.quote: Contextual advertising departs from the traditional behavioural approach of making sure ads are relevant to a user. Instead, a contextual targeting approach aims to ensure the ad is relevant to the content of that page.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's example describes a drug rehabilitation center running a cookieless campaign that serves ads on blogs with tips on 'how to get started with rehabilitation,' and says this works without using any private user information.
